lines: The Asai family of the Igawa clan. A family of three had disappeared, and later turned out to have been killed.
Because of the misanga bracelet that had been left behind in their mansion, the existence of a mysterious fourth person had emerged.
That fourth person was said to still be alive. Was it someone related to the case? Was it the culprit behind the serial killings?
The clue was the letters “Yamakuro”, which Koro-senpai had sensed.
We had decided to head back to school for the moment, to investigate their identity.
There were special information devices at school which, apart from Gosha's upper echelons, only the Public Order Unit was allowed access to.
We had decided to try looking up Yamakuro with those first, but
Unfortunately, no matter how much we searched through the data, first on Gosha's residents and then on various other things, we weren't able to get any information on them.
「It's a dead end for now, huh?」
「Is there no one in Gosha named Yamakuro?」
「We don't even know whether it's a person's name, though.」
「You don't have to get so discouraged. I didn't think we'd find them easily, even with Gosha's information terminals.」
「I see. So, what do we do after this?」
「I've thought of a plan, of course, but what would Fuuma-kun do?」
Since I had had that asked back to me instead, I thought about it for moment, and then answered,
「I suppose I'd go back to the estate from before. It doesn't really have to be right now, but they do say you should scour a crime scene a hundred times, so...」
「It's less that Fuuma-chan's reliable, and more like generally, when he's acting that way, the next incident happens, and he sinks his teeth into that. Right?」
「......Well, that's not entirely untrue. That doesn't mean I'm hoping for it, though.」
「Ahahaha. That's great. Just what I expected♪」
Both my senpais were pleased, but I wasn't too happy. Damn Hebiko.
「I'm fine with counting on Fuuma-kun's ability, but before that, we're going to meet with the “Gosha information expert”.」
「Hebiko doesn't know about them either. Sometimes her senpais go just by themselves, see?」
「Yeah, come to think of it, that's true. Then this is perfect.」
「Koro-chan, would it be okay for us to set off now? Is it still too early?」
「（We'll be there right at opening time.）」
My senpais said, looking at their watches.
「Are they an information dealer or something?」
「It's strange for an informant to have set opening hours.」
「Fufu, you'll understand when we get there.」
Nao-senpai smiled meaningfully, and began walking in the direction of town.
We had exited the Academy into Gosha Village.
By the time we arrived at the main street, it was evening.
Right now, we were in a small downtown area in front of the station.
Well, I call it that, but since this was a rural town, it was just a few restaurants.
「All right, we've arrived. This is it.」
What our senpais had stopped in front of was
And then, a familiar face appeared from inside the bar.

「Sake, sake, saaa-keee♪ When you're drinking
saaa-keee♪
——Mm?」
A can of strong alcohol, a cigarette in her mouth, and a large sword on her back.
It was Kouzuki Sana-senpai, user of the Liquor Escape Arts, where the drunker she got, the stronger she became.
「Oh, you guys?! You come to drink here togeth――― Ohh?!」
「You guys're with them too, huh?!! Koro's voice is as quiet as ever! And Nao's dressed cute, like always!」
「Sana-senpai's the same as always too, eh?」
「That's 'cuz it's my bar. How 'bout it? Latecomer's lament, three bottles 'til you catch up. Down the hatch!」
「I appreciate it, but we're on Public Order Unit duty.」
「Strict as ever, huh? That's Gosha's paragon of public morals for you!」
「（Senpai used to drink, even during Public Order activities.）」
「That's true. It is me, after all, right? Ahahahahaha!!」
She was completely wasted. Like always.
「Eeeeeeeehhh?!! Sana-san's our Public Order Unit senpai?!」
Seeing the three of them talking in a friendly manner, Hebiko was astonished.
「Oi oi, your voice is too loud, Hebiko!」
「Well, pretty much. That's a fact that no one knows apart from Koro-chan and me, even within the Public Order Unit.」
「Sana-san! Why did you never tell Hebiko you were a former Public Order Unit member before, when we got put together on that mission?」
「You did not! Hebiko's just finding out for the first time now!」
「Is that a fact? Ahaha, sorry, sorry.」
「We're fellow Taimanin, so, like, don't worry too much about the junior-senior stuff.」
Seeing Hebiko looking dissatisfied, Nao-senpai smiled as she said,
「Sana-senpai keeps it secret that she was in the Public Order Unit because it'll harm her image.」
「Having used to be in the Public Order Unit? Why's that?」
「Wh-Why, you ask... It just feels like it!」
「I'm saying, don't sweat small stuff like that. Okay? Okay?」
What the hell about having used to be in the Public Order Unit, which maintained law and order in Gosha, would damage her image?
「Ah, I get it. It's because it would ruin your “hoodlum” image, right?」
「Hey! Why you, Fuuma...! What're you sayin', ya stupid ass?!」
「We already know. That Sana-senpai may usually act like a bad guy, but she's a serious hard-worker.」
「Th-That's not true!! I'm as loutish as I look!!」
「I'm just a drunken swordsman who hates boring hard work!!」
She insisted, despite being so shaken that she was trembling her hands and spilling the contents of her can of strong alcohol.
Why was she so intent on pretending to be a bad guy?
Nao-senpai and Koro-senpai were laughing, and Hebiko was making an exasperated-looking face.
「Wh-What'd you guys come here for?! This is a bar! If you're not gonna drink, then go home!」
Sana-senpai was making her face bright red, not from alcohol, but embarrassment.
「I told you, it's Public Order Unit duty. We came to ask something from Sana-senpai, the “Gosha information expert”.」
「Tch, there's no choice, then. You're in the way, standing there, so get in.」
It looked like she had only just opened, yet there were already a fair few customers in the bar, and others on their way back from work were turning up one after another.
「Yeah, welcome. My juniors came to visit, so wait inside for a bit.」
「Sana-chan, three large mugs of beer. And some edamame.」
「Thanks for your continued patronage! Could you make a little space with that chair over there? Sorry!」
She dealt with her customers efficiently, as though her flustered state a moment ago were a lie.
It was understandable that Sana-senpai, who was formerly of the Public Order Unit, and ran the only bar in town, would be the “Gosha information expert”.
Perhaps out of consideration for it being Public Order Unit duty, she led us through to a seat in the back.
「So, what do you want to ask me?」
Nao-senpai gave her an outline of the case.
The serial killings that had been going on for ten years.
The Asai house, where an entire family had been murdered.
The fact that we had been attacked by mud golems there.
The hair misanga bracelet that had been left on the premises.
「So I take it you're looking for that fourth person?」
「Yes. When we had Koro-chan scan it for us, the name Yamakuro came up. Do you know them?」
「It didn't come up in Gosha's database.」
「Hmmm...... Yamakuro...... Yamakuro, eh......? I feel like I've heard that somewhere......」
She tilted her strong beer can and let her eyes drift through space.
「Ahh, Old Man Yamakuro! There was a person like that in the old days.」
「Nah, he's not here now. He died when I was a kid.」
After shaking her head and taking a glance at me, Sana-senpai continued,
「As I recall, he got caught up in the Fuuma-Igawa conflict.」
Hebiko looked at me with concern.
「Sana-senpai, is the house where that person used to live still around?」
「The house where Old Man Yamakuro used to live? Let me see. It would be an abandoned house now, wouldn't it? If I remember rightly......」
Sana-senpai took out a bar order pad, and quickly wrote the address for us on the back of it.
The Unit's two current senpais stood up without hesitation.
「Oi? You took all the trouble of coming here, so at least have a drink.」
Having venom spat at us by our alumnus (who liked to pretend to be a hoodlum, but was kind at heart), I left the bar feeling slightly apologetic.
The Yamakuro house, a name that had even disappeared from Gosha's database.
That place, which was now an abandoned building, was in the mountains a fair ways away from town.
On top of there being fewer people, the sun was rapidly setting.
「Um...... Nao-senpai, the sun's about to set.」
Like when we first met, Nao-senpai pulled on my tie, and asked that at a range where our lips were practically touching again, even though Hebiko and Koro-senpai were there as well.
Hebiko was making scary eyes, and Koro-senpai was strangely pumped-up.
As a troublemaker, I had nothing but a bad feeling about this, but it looked like I had no choice but to follow them.
And by the time we arrived, the sun had set entirely.
「It's like the very picture of a haunted house, huh?」
「If Shikanosuke-chan were here, he'd be crying.」
Only Koro-senpai, the Soul Escape Art user, was making her eyes light up at the house, which looked like something was going to come out of it and attack us.
「How about it, Koro-chan? Are there any traces of people?」
「（There are. And not from that long ago.）」
「Assuming that misanga was a message to us......」
「Then do they want to show us something here?」
「Well, you can't get the tiger's cub without entering its den.」
We couldn't come this far and then turn back.
We set foot on the site of the haunted house, and that moment,
